category: External self-service portal for government and semi-public organisations (a mijn-omgeving or PIP with its public website): citizens, businesses and supply-chain partners sign in with DigiD, eHerkenning, eIDAS or an OIDC broker, see and act on their own cases, messages, tasks, documents and forms from every back-office app in one white-label portal, while the organisation runs the public site around it (pages, menus, glossary, search, landing pages) and measures its visitors. Staff stay inside Nextcloud. Buyers compare it with a municipal citizen portal (Open Inwoner Platform, NL Portal, the PIP inside xxllnc Zaken), with the national MijnOverheid, and with a general digital experience platform such as Liferay DXP.
